decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 23 caused a collision with Car 20 in turn 1.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence. In turn 1 at the apex, the driver of Car 23 oversteered, corrected but as a result collided with Car 20.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Causing A Collision
